item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 18 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 18 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 11:00 PM, 18 August 2026(Tuesday)

RED WARNING LEVEL: Bataan, Batangas(Nasugbu, Lian, Tuy, Balayan, Calatagan, Calaca) and Cavite(Ternate, Maragondon, Magallanes, General Emilio Aguinaldo, Alfonso).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Serious FLOODING in flood-prone areas.

ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Metro Manila, Zambales, Bulacan, Cavite(Amadeo, General Trias, Indang, Mendez, Silang, Tagaytay, Trece Martires, Bacoor, Carmona, Cavite City, Dasmarinas, Gen. Mariano Alvarez, Imus, Kawit, Naic, Noveleta, Rosario, Tanza), Rizal(Rodriguez, San Mateo, Cainta, Antipolo, Taytay, Angono), Pampanga(Lubao, Sasmuan, Macabebe, Masantol, Floridablanca, Porac) and Batangas(Agoncillo, Alitagtag, Balete, Batangas City, Bauan, Tanauan, Cuenca, Ibaan, Laurel, Lemery, Lipa, Lobo, Mabini, Malvar, Mataasnakahoy, Padre Garcia, Rosario, San Jose, San Juan, San Luis, San Nicolas, San Pascual, Santa Teresita, Santo Tomas, Taal, Talisay, Taysan, Tingloy).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING is THREATENING.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Tarlac, Pampanga(Apalit, Arayat, Bacolor, Candaba, San Fernando, Magalang, Mexico, Minalin, San Luis, San Simon, Santa Ana, Santo Tomas, Angeles, Mabalacat, Guagua, Santa Rita), Laguna(San Pedro, Santa Maria, Mabitac, Pakil, Siniloan, Famy, Pangil, Cabuyao, Binan, Santa Rosa, Calamba) and Rizal(Tanay, Baras, Binangonan, Cardona, Jala-Jala, Morong, Pililla, Teresa).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Possible FLOODING in flood-prone areas.


Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Laguna(Alaminos, Bay, Calauan, Liliw, Los Banos, Luisiana, Magdalena, Majayjay, Nagcarlan, Pagsanjan, Pila, Rizal, San Pablo, Santa Cruz, Victoria, Cavinti, Kalayaan, Lumban, Paete) within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Nueva Ecija and Quezon(General Nakar, Infanta, Real) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 2:00 AM tomorrow.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.
